# FOSS Andhra

> Promoting free and open source software across Andhra Pradesh through education, governance, and community programs.

## Organization
- Type: Non-Governmental Organization (NGO)
- Location: Yesj Centre for Excellence, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh 520008, India
- Contact: office@fossap.in | +91 94944 63840
- Website: https://fossap.in

## Mission
Digitalizing education, governance, and society through free and open source solutions across Andhra Pradesh.

## Core Values
- Open Knowledge: Making knowledge freely accessible to everyone
- Data Privacy: Protecting user rights and digital sovereignty
- Public Welfare: Prioritizing societal benefit over commercial interests
- Offline First: Building solutions that work without constant internet access

## Programs

### FOSStar — Membership Program
Connect with the FOSS community across Andhra Pradesh. Tiers for students, professionals, and institutions.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosstar

### FOSServe — Education & Governance Solutions
Promoting open source software adoption in Andhra Pradesh's educational institutions and government bodies.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosserve

### FOSSynC — Student FOSS Clubs
Establishing student-led open source clubs in colleges across Andhra Pradesh.
https://fossap.in/programs/fossync

### FOSStorm — Community Projects
Developing open source projects that address local challenges in Andhra Pradesh.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosstorm

### FOSStart — Startup Incubation
Supporting open source startups in Andhra Pradesh with funding, mentorship, and networking.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosstart

### FOSSterage — Knowledge Repository
Curated open source resources, documentation, and learning materials.
https://fossap.in/programs/fossterage

### FOSSpeaks — Advocacy & Outreach
Public speaking, workshops, and advocacy for FOSS adoption across Andhra Pradesh.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosspeaks

## Community Stats
- 500+ community members
- 50+ events hosted
- 7 active programs
- 20+ institutions reached
